newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 532,100 metric tons (MT) were three times the previous week and two and three-tenths times the 4-week average. The primary buyers were Pakistan (282,000 MT), Japan (61,700 MT), Jordan (55,000 MT), Ecuador (27,000 MT), and South Korea (26,700 MT).
Net sales increases of 173,400 MT for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year were primarily for South Korea (62,400 MT), Jordan (25,000 MT), Italy (22,000 MT), and Japan (20,000 MT).

Exports of 275,300 MT were off 35 percent from the week earlier and two-fifths from the 4-week average. The principal recipients were South Korea (68,900 MT), Japan (61,700 MT), the Philippines (36,800 MT), and Algeria (18,900 MT).
